purpose: MDB Resolution review: native geometry versus effective presentation bounds, MDVx ordinary raster omission, actual own-descriptor geometry, current selector and proposed simpler Bella numeric data flow.
status: User approved preserving current Resolution crop/field/proxy rules and useful tests, numeric dimensions with compact state, late display/export formatting, numeric sorting and conditional Sampled decoding for MDB on 20 October 2026. Not yet implemented; OldScanner active and Bin Filter unchanged.

mediaComposer.scope: Read-only arm64 static inspection of the installed Media Composer engine for physical-file MDB Resolution requirements. No application launch, private API execution, media writes, production edits or universal UI behavior claim.
ownershipAndApplicability: Known video descriptors CDCI, RGBA and MPGI use DIDDescriptor geometry. CDCI and RGBA Get call DIDDescriptor::Get; MPGI Get calls CDCIDescriptor::Get. Use the approved full-ID-qualified physical file mob own MOBJ:PhysicalMedia descriptor.

The agreed PCMA, AIFD and WAVD audio kinds do not supply picture-raster dimensions. Bella can leave Resolution not applicable/blank for those rows. A bounded native image-size formatter also rejects a composition with no video tracks; this is not a claim that every UI table shares that exact route.

recordedFields.nativeWireAccess: The ten dimensions/offsets use signed Int32 stream access; FrameLayout uses signed Int16 access. Actual MDB declared types and widths are checked separately by the raw-file inventory. These are numeric binary fields in the applicable object byte order, not UTF-8/MacRoman strings.
recordedFields.numericStorage: DIDGeometry stores each dimension/offset in a 32-bit field; its public getters return unsigned values. The getter signature is not permission to reinterpret a negative/damaged stored Int32 as a usable huge raster.
recordedFields.otherFields: Native geometry also handles ImageAspectRatio and VideoLineMap. Pixel aspect/presentation conversion and field line maps are separate from the current MediaMuster visible-raster column and need not become new table columns.

bellaRecommendationToParent: Preserve the current established visible-raster meaning and specimen-backed proxy exception, using a small new numeric geometry record and a bounded selector rather than importing Media Composer composition/presentation/codec-repair machinery.

Retain the selected physical descriptor own Stored/Sampled/Display dimensions and offsets, the applicable wire-layout convention and necessary coding/resolution identifiers for the existing exact proxy lookup. This is a compact set of facts, not a complete runtime metadata graph.

Keep current format-specific coordinate/default validation: OMF/MDB sampled and display offsets are relative to Stored; MXF has its separately reviewed coordinate/default rules. Absence-only defaults and malformed/conflicting-field behavior are explicit Bella requirements, not conclusions from the native zero test.

Compute a numeric selected width and full-frame height once. Format the familiar width x height label only at the display boundary; leave audio blank and keep unknown/damaged video rows with unavailable Resolution.

Keep DNx compression-name geometry/rate logic separate, as the user explicitly wants existing Compression behavior preserved. Do not replace naming geometry with the table-visible Resolution by accident.

For OMF/MDB only, Sampled need not be decoded before selecting an ordinary usable Display rectangle validated independently within Stored. Decode Sampled when an otherwise qualified exact proxy candidate needs it. This follows the existing format-specific physical-raster contract; it is not a claim that Media Composer itself conditionally skips those reads. Future MXF handling remains separate because its rectangles are nested.

It is prior source/specimen evidence, not a Media Composer native UI proof. Root/data agent is independently checking current corpus and current helper elegance.

mdvx.purpose: Bounded MDVx ordinary MDB Resolution audit: determine whether physical dimensions are acquired, stored or displayed; distinguish DIDResolutionID codec naming from geometry.
mdvx.method: Fresh installed binary SHA256 and fresh direct arm64 CFString decoding. Re-read exact previously captured functions for that identical hash. No app launch, live scan/CSV, private API invocation, new media/database read or production edit.
mdvx.mainFinding: The inspected ordinary inventory does not project a separate physical Resolution width/height field. Its descriptor helper, row model and table/string-export branches provide no geometry selection/formatting rule to copy. A dictionary named resolutionIDDictionary supplies CompressionString labels rather than measured image dimensions.

ordinaryMdbAcquisition.entry: -[MDVxOMFI addInfoToItem:] 0x100064794 resolves the PMR-associated FILE SourceMob using its eight-byte ID excerpt, then calls getCompression_data:forObjAt: at 0x100064ae4.
ordinaryMdbAcquisition.descriptorHelper: -[MDVxOMFI getCompression_data:forObjAt:] 0x100064b60 resolves MOBJ:PhysicalMedia0x10333 at 0x100064b9c..bc4. The complete helper queries compression, DIDResolutionID, rate/FrameSampleSize and depth properties listed in the bounded-negative receipt.
ordinaryMdbAcquisition.geometry: No StoredWidth/Height, SampledWidth/Height, DisplayWidth/Height, offsets, FrameLayout, video-line map or image-aspect property is queried by this helper.
ordinaryMdbAcquisition.noAlgorithm: No stored/sampled/display raster priority, rectangle bounds validation, field-height doubling, crop/offset handling, thin-raster expansion or qualified proxy-raster exception occurs in this ordinary helper. This is an omitted field, not an asserted alternate geometry policy.
ordinaryMdbAcquisition.dimensionTypeWidthEndian: No ordinary dimension reader was found here, so no dimension payload type/width/endian rule is established by this path. Do not confuse the unrelated32-bit DIDResolutionID scalar with width or height.

DIDResolutionIDIsSeparate.read: Non-audio helper branch queries it at 0x100064c90..ca0, obtains data and loads a32-bit word at 0x100064cb4. Whole-word byte reversal when _isII is false is selected at 0x100064cb8..cc0; result stored in helper output+0x0c at 0x100064cc4.
DIDResolutionIDIsSeparate.guards: This is reached only after neither audio marker branch matches and DIDD:Compression property is present. DIDResolutionID itself is optional; helper output begins zero-initialized. A nearby FrameSampleSize/rate condition belongs another returned intermediate, not width/height.
DIDResolutionIDIsSeparate.row: addInfoToItem copies it via setDB_DIDResolutionID: at 0x100064afc..b04. Getter0x1000315a4 and setter0x1000315ac read/write unsigned32 row+0x68; row metadata declares an unsigned integer.
DIDResolutionIDIsSeparate.meaning: It is a recorded Avid format/resolution identifier used for naming. It is not a raster count, and retaining it does not establish the physical visible or stored dimensions.

compressionNameDictionary.consumer: -[MDVxPMRScannerOperation setCompressionStringForItem:] 0x10003b494 obtains resolutionIDDictionary at 0x10003b4d4, creates unsigned NSNumber from row DIDResolutionID at 0x10003b4f0..4fc, looks up a label at 0x10003b514 and assigns DB_CompressionString at 0x10003b52c.
compressionNameDictionary.interpretation: These are compression/profile names, sometimes including a conventional raster-family/rate label. This routine does not inspect actual dimensions or derive a physical WxH result from those strings.
compressionNameDictionary.fallback: If the lookup returns nil and FourCC first byte is nonzero,0x10003b56c..5ec builds a CompressionString from the four FourCC bytes and DIDResolutionID using exact format %c%c%c%c ID:%u at 0x10003b5c8. It does not make up a geometry value.
compressionNameDictionary.proxyLimit: Apple ProRes Proxy is one codec-profile dictionary label, not a measured proxy raster or a known stored-vs-display geometry override.

headerAndWholeAppLimits.scope: No claim that the embedded library or raw database browser cannot decode dimensions, or that every possible app panel omits them. This is the traced ordinary matched-file scanner→row→table/CSV path.

Retained identity, catalogue, descriptor-reference, class, geometry and codec-context properties are reconstructed from actual MDB byte ranges and compared byte-for-byte with cached entries.

Complete normalized PMR FileMobId resolves its unique physical MOBJ in SourceMobs and ObjectSpine. Full paired MasterMobId is separately qualified in the composition catalogue. Only the FileMob own PhysicalMedia target supplies geometry.

Each Stored, Sampled and Display dimension or offset is inventoried separately. Long dimensions/offsets decode as concrete signed little-endian 32-bit values. FrameLayout is inventoried as its concrete omfi:LayoutType, two bytes, unsigned little-endian.

Optional-set completeness is counted separately for dimension pairs and dimension/offset quartets. Raw width/height comparisons do not multiply heights, crop, apply offsets or infer semantic frame sizes.

Own native resolution ID, codec tag/GUID and MDES Intermediate marker are context only. Context groups are preserved to qualify later native-source proxy/codec interpretation without choosing a runtime precedence rule.
Audio descriptor geometry presence/absence is audited; no video geometry is borrowed for audio.

Every distinct video raw geometry and codec context has a representative full-ID qualified ownership chain and exact raw property ranges. Every row with differing raw rectangles or nonzero offsets is listed separately.
No physical media header, essence, OldScanner projection or production parser output is used.

limits: These are source facts, not approval of Stored/Sampled/Display precedence, proxy exceptions, frame-layout multiplication or final formatting.

Raw geometry inequality alone does not identify cropping, padding, active pixels, proxy scaling, frame-versus-field sizes or intended display raster. Those meanings require qualified native/format evidence.

All six MDBs use established little-endian legacy Bento layouts. Unsupported widths/types, missing/partial/conflicting geometry, nonpositive dimensions, unknown layout values and other containers may remain unexercised.
StoredXOffset and StoredYOffset are explicitly checked for absence; their spelling here is an observation query and does not invent a schema field or fallback.
Codec/resolution identifiers and Intermediate markers are retained as context without assigning a proxy classification or guessing a raster.
No repo, app, media, input or runtime policy writes occur. New probes and evidence are confined to this /private/tmp directory.

currentMediaMuster.helper: Small value-only PictureGeometry -> VisibleGeometry selector, picturegeometry_p.h. Positive rectangles, safe containment and checked field-height multiplication; exact proxy table.
currentMediaMuster.mdbSemantics: Display and Sampled each Stored-relative. Genuinely absent optional dimensions default to Stored and offsets to zero only after complete object/source read. Present invalid/unreadable/conflicting data receives no absence default. Legacy partial sets use toolkit compatibility defaults.
currentMediaMuster.heightContext: Current MDB/OMF layout 1 doubles per-field height; known legacy OMF1 layout 3 doubles as a separate convention. Single-field layout 2 is not automatically doubled. The raw layout code alone without supported wire context is insufficient.
currentMediaMuster.proxy: Exact full H.264 coding UL, supported ID, all three rasters, zero offsets and layout; unexplained out-of-bounds Display stays unavailable.
currentMediaMuster.presentation: The helper returns numeric qint64 width/height plus origin; caller converts to QString WxH in observations, adapter copies it into row. Table/CSV use the string; sorting parses width/height again.
currentMediaMuster.sourceSelection: Current eligible media-header Resolution results outrank MDB when already read. General Bella source/header scheduling remains a later review.
currentMediaMuster.historicalLimit: The dated physical-header/ffprobe corroboration remains historical evidence. Current audit verifies MDB values and matching exact configurations; it did not reopen media or rerun those probes.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by the user on 20 October 2026; not yet implemented.
agreedBellaRule.ownership: Full FileMobId -> qualified own file mob -> own video descriptor CDCI/RGBA/MPGI. Audio Resolution inapplicable/blank; no master/project/presentation-size borrowing.
readOrdinaryMdb: necessary supported object/wire-revision and field-read states
agreedBellaRule.conditionalSampled: For MDB, validate Stored-relative Display independently. Decode Sampled dimensions/offsets when needed to establish the exact proxy exception. A known proxy candidate also needs the exact coding UL and ResolutionID with all matching geometry/layout/offsets. Native reads all fields, but no requirement to reproduce that schedule was established.
agreedBellaRule.separateMxf: Do not apply this selective MDB rule to future MXF without its own source review: nested Sampled parent/defaults/coordinates remain distinct.
agreedBellaRule.selection: Preserve current visible-raster crop, format-qualified height/default and exact proxy rules and useful controlled tests. Missing crop does not justify inventing 1080; invalid crop does not justify a generic Stored fallback.
agreedBellaRule.bounds: Positive dimensions, valid applicable layout/context, known offsets and checked containment. Use subtraction after size checks and checked field-height multiplication; avoid silent integer narrowing.
agreedBellaRule.missing: Absent defaults only when absence is established; unreadable/damaged/conflicting/unsupported video geometry unavailable/blank at MDB stage, keep physical row. General MDB damage/header-read policies remain later requirements.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Selected numeric width/height plus compact origin/availability; temporary rectangles/type states and necessary coding inputs only as long as their consumers require them. No persistent complete property graph or formatted Resolution string required.
agreedBellaRule.presentation: Keep existing WxH raster labels such as 1920x1080, generated at display/export; numeric width then height sorting. Pixel aspect/composition reformatting does not stretch this physical-raster result.
agreedBellaRule.compressionBoundary: Preserved Compression must receive its existing required geometry and format facts. Do not substitute the table cropped/proxy label for its independent naming inputs or alter its rules.
agreedBellaRule.cpp17Qt653: Small value records and checked qint64 arithmetic; pinned Qt endian readers after typed bounds validation. QSize is an optional checked int-range presentation value, not automatic support for huge dimensions; isValid accepts zero, so require positive raster dimensions.
agreedBellaRule.elegance: Current geometry core is already compact. Simplify the Bella readers/adapters, selective decoding and numeric result flow; no reason to replace working crop arithmetic with a framework.
limits: No measured speed/memory or file-open improvement claimed.
No new runtime code, tests, builds, app cutover or Bin Filter change.
